description: Shared thread filter of the PDF annotation panels (TmPdfViewer and TmPdfAnnotator, phase 12): the 'All (N) | Unresolved (M)' segmented control rendered in both panels' headers. It replaced the phase-4 'Show resolved' checkbox — the All segment maps onto ShowResolved=true and Unresolved onto false, so the public panel contract is unchanged. The segments are native radios sharing one group name (the TmRadioGroup Appearance=Segmented model): the browser owns the arrow keys and there is no keyboard emulation. Counts recompute from Threads on every render, so resolve/reopen mutations update them live.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: Annotation threads whose All/Unresolved counts are shown.

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads are shown — All (true) or Unresolved only (false).

parameters.name: ShowResolvedChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the filter changes: All raises true, Unresolved raises false.

parameters.name: TestIdBase
parameters.description: Base of the owning panel's testid contract (e.g. pdf-annotation or pdf-annotator); the group renders {base}-filter with the segments {base}-filter-all and {base}-filter-unresolved.
